sources: it.wikipedia: Serie A 1947-1948 (final table, participants) and the 21 club season pages '<club> 1947-1948' (squads, league appearances, coaches, kits); cached in raw/itwiki, drafted by tools/itwiki_season.py
Juventus appearances: national-football-teams.com (club 1292, 1947/48) and it.wikipedia player pages; Inter appearances: inter.it player archive, RSSSF and it.wikipedia player pages
SWOS 2020 '1900s Retro Pack Teams (1900-1970)' by FrancescoManetti82 and Gorzo (SWOS United): TORINO 1947 ratings
SWOS 96/97: positions and kits of the 1996-97 Italian clubs (TEAM.020) as templates
notes: No national cup: the Coppa Italia was not played from 1943 to 1958 (RSSSF Italy - Coppa Italia history). No European club cups in 1947-48.
21 clubs (Triestina readmitted in July 1947): 42 rounds, every club rests twice, 2 points per win, 4 relegated (Salernitana, Alessandria, Vicenza, Napoli).
Napoli finished on 34 points but was placed last for an attempted bribe (Bologna-Napoli): the game cannot replay that, so the bottom 4 on the pitch go down.
Juventus and Inter: the club pages have no appearance table; players with known appearances first (sources above), then the others in squad-box order.
Kits: 1996-97 game kits; Alessandria, Triestina from the 1947-48 page kit box; Pro Patria (white, blue shorts) and Livorno (maroon, white shorts) by hand.
Ratings: Torino from the 1900s Retro Pack; the other 20 clubs calibrated on the final points (average price 18 at 26 points to 30 at 49 points).
